# Specialist AI Agent Kits

> eight runnable offline Python specialist tools and eleven customizable AI agent starter profiles, distributed as MIT-licensed source ZIPs. This is not a native installation of autonomous Muse agents, nor a native Muse agent deployment.

Project: https://github.com/sethburkhardt21-dev/muse-ai-agent-presets
Current release: v0.4.1-alpha
The eight executable ZIPs can run locally with requirements specified by their guides. Eleven starter-profile ZIPs are editable role/configuration sources, not already running model-backed assistants. External connectors are disabled by default. Model Builder examples use small synthetic models, not large-language-model training. This repository-level index is optional and publication does not guarantee automatic AI search indexing.

## Product information
- [Getting started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sethburkhardt21-dev/muse-ai-agent-presets/main/docs/GITHUB_QUICKSTART.md): Python requirements, runnable examples and starter versus executable packages.
- [Capability matrix](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sethburkhardt21-dev/muse-ai-agent-presets/main/docs/CAPABILITIES.md): executable features and unsupported integrations.
- [Agent questions and limitations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sethburkhardt21-dev/muse-ai-agent-presets/main/docs/discovery/AI_AGENT_GUIDE.md): common questions an AI assistant should answer from evidence.
- [Machine-readable capability inventory](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sethburkhardt21-dev/muse-ai-agent-presets/main/docs/discovery/agent-capabilities.json): package IDs, verified download paths and capability boundaries.
- [Current verified release](https://github.com/sethburkhardt21-dev/muse-ai-agent-presets/releases/tag/v0.4.1-alpha): official ZIP downloads and checksums.

## Runnable offline tools
- [Coordinator executable](https://github.com/sethburkhardt21-dev/muse-ai-agent-presets/releases/download/v0.4.1-alpha/coordinator-executable-v0.4.1-alpha.zip): offline task/plan review.
- [Software Engineer executable](https://github.com/sethburkhardt21-dev/muse-ai-agent-presets/releases/download/v0.4.1-alpha/software-engineer-executable-v0.4.1-alpha.zip): reviewed disposable Git engineering workflow.
- [Model Builder executable](https://github.com/sethburkhardt21-dev/muse-ai-agent-presets/releases/download/v0.4.1-alpha/model-builder-executable-v0.4.1-alpha.zip): deterministic small-model training/evaluation examples.
- [Claims Adjudicator executable](https://github.com/sethburkhardt21-dev/muse-ai-agent-presets/releases/download/v0.4.1-alpha/claims-adjudicator-executable-v0.4.1-alpha.zip): bounded claim/evidence classification.
- [Garden Companion executable](https://github.com/sethburkhardt21-dev/muse-ai-agent-presets/releases/download/v0.4.1-alpha/garden-companion-executable-v0.4.1-alpha.zip): local SQLite garden/calendar examples.
- [Learning Coach executable](https://github.com/sethburkhardt21-dev/muse-ai-agent-presets/releases/download/v0.4.1-alpha/learning-coach-executable-v0.4.1-alpha.zip): offline source-backed study and scores.
- [Reverse Engineering & Security Researcher executable](https://github.com/sethburkhardt21-dev/muse-ai-agent-presets/releases/download/v0.4.1-alpha/reverse-engineering-researcher-executable-v0.4.1-alpha.zip): bounded comparison of supplied, offline observations, not live scanning.
- [Creative Studio executable](https://github.com/sethburkhardt21-dev/muse-ai-agent-presets/releases/download/v0.4.1-alpha/creative-studio-executable-v0.4.1-alpha.zip): textual storyboard and production planner, not an image or animation renderer.

## Optional
- [Security and permissions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sethburkhardt21-dev/muse-ai-agent-presets/main/docs/SECURITY.md): local OS account execution is not a sandbox.
